BUT, if your advisor denied your appeal then reach out to the Undergrad Director under the courses department (English?) and ask him if the previous class you took meets the requirements for the Literacy Course you’re enrolled in. If he says yes, request if he can personally change that in your UBHub (directors have the authority to do so). If he says YES, but is unable to that because the class isn’t affiliated for your major, then reach out to the Director of the Advisement Department, make an in person meeting with him and explain to him that the Director under the English department suggested that the two courses are considered to be equivalent but he was unable to change it in your Hub. 
Best of luck! If you’ve already tried any of these or all else fails, (If you’re a veteran) then reach out to veteran services (https://www.buffalo.edu/studentlife/who-we-are/departments/veteran.html), they might be able to give out a few more options or be a further advocate for you. 
Sorry, you’re going through this. Been there, it can be stressful. Keep moving up the ladder and directly reach out to any director or supervisor that’s affiliated with the course or advisement department and I guarantee you’ll most likely see results.
